acceptanceCriteria: The session-start digest emits at most the P0 tickets plus a count per priority and the read command (`corvint-tasks roadmap`) instead of every OPEN ticket.

Measured SessionStart additional context stays under the host's inline limit (no persisted-output overflow) on the current store; the before and after byte counts are recorded in the ticket completion.
body: The SessionStart context observed 2026-09-24 was 11.4 KB, overflowed to a persisted file, and was mostly a list of all 100 OPEN tickets emitted by the operator-global hook `~/.claude/hooks/agent-memory-digest.sh` (outside this repository, so touchPaths is empty). It spends the agent's attention budget before any task exists and contradicts evidence-explains-its-inclusion. Lesson 33 of the source recommends a small router plus progressive disclosure. Source: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch, Phase 14 agent-workbench track, reviewed 2026-09-24.
title: session-start: cap the task-store digest so the hook stops injecting every open ticket
